{{Bulbanews|Pokémon Seasons 1-19 Deluxe Edition to be released in Australia}} [[File:PokemonSeasons1-19DeluxeEditionRegion4.jpg|thumb|Pokémon Seasons 1-19: Deluxe Edition]] '''''Pokémon Seasons 1-19: Deluxe Edition''''' is a Region 4 DVD released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in [[Pokémon in Australia|Australia]] on November 1, 2017 and in [[Pokémon in New Zealand|New Zealand]] on November 15, 2017. It contains a total of 112 discs with a total runtime of approximately 341 hours from the Slimpack releases of the first 19 [[season]]s of {{aniseries|PTS}}. Its catalogue number is BHE7754. The DVDs included in this set are encoded in the {{wp|PAL}} color-coding system, and are region-locked to {{wp|DVD region code|DVD region 4}}.
